provider: gitcrawl 0.5.0 backed by GitHub REST metadata
rawCommand: gitcrawl search issues "" -R ProseMirror/prosemirror --state all --json number,title,state,url,labels,updatedAt --limit 10000
cursorDeltaSemantics: Counts include only rows whose lastMetadataRefreshAt matches refreshedAt.

hostVerification.countCommand: gh api graphql -f query='query { repository(owner:"ProseMirror", name:"prosemirror") { all: issues { totalCount } open: issues(states:OPEN) { totalCount } closed: issues(states:CLOSED) { totalCount } } }' --jq '.data.repository'
hostVerification.omissionCommand: gh api graphql -f query='query { repository(owner:"ProseMirror", name:"prosemirror") { i1238: issue(number:1238){number state title updatedAt url labels(first:100){nodes{name}}} i1271: issue(number:1271){number state title updatedAt url labels(first:100){nodes{name}}} } }' --jq '.data.repository'

omittedIssues.title: Inline nodes with editable content behave unexpectedly
Backspacing the last character in a paragraph hangs on iOS Safari
